blocks.text: The daily grind of a risk specialist

Your day likely starts with a review of flagged items in your inbox. You are managing control owners and tracking audit evidence. This requires constant context switching. You move between your GRC dashboard and Outlook to confirm receipt of documentation.

Many risk specialists struggle with the sheer volume of email. You must ensure every communication is compliant and archived. The New Outlook for Mac interface helps by grouping related threads. Use the search bar with filters to find specific audit evidence quickly.
Optimizing your Outlook for Mac setup

Start by cleaning up your workspace. If you have too many folders, use ⌘ + Shift + E to create new ones. Keep your inbox lean by archiving items that do not require immediate action. If you feel overwhelmed, turn off Focused Inbox via Outlook > Settings > Reading to see all your mail in one chronological feed.

Use ⌘ + 2 to switch to your Calendar for meeting scheduling.

blocks.text: Common mistakes in risk management workflows

A frequent error is storing sensitive audit evidence in local draft folders. Always ensure your attachments are uploaded to your secure GRC platform. Use Outlook rules to automatically move emails with specific keywords to a dedicated folder. This keeps your main inbox clear for urgent stakeholder requests.

Another mistake is failing to update your macOS. Microsoft 365 requires macOS 14 or later to receive critical security patches. Check your version in the Apple menu > About This Mac. If you are on an older OS, you might lose access to important features or face sync errors like the common -3253 connection error.
What to do next to improve your outlook

Review your current email rules. Are they still relevant? If not, delete them. Create a template for your most common risk follow-up emails. You can save these as drafts or use a text expansion tool. This ensures consistency in your communication across the department.

If you are still using the Legacy Outlook, prepare for the transition. Microsoft is retiring legacy support for Exchange Online. Use the Outlook menu to toggle to the New Outlook and test your workflows. Ensure your OLM files are backed up if you need to migrate local data.

faq.answer: No. Lazur is a voice assistant that guides you. It will point at buttons or explain how to perform a task, but it does not click or operate the app for you.

faq.question: Why is my Outlook for Mac slow?
faq.answer: Performance issues often stem from large local databases or sync conflicts. Ensure you are on the latest version of macOS and Outlook. Try clearing your cache or rebuilding your identity if the problem persists.

faq.question: How do I create a rule in Outlook for Mac?
faq.answer: Go to Tools > Rules. Select the account and click the plus sign to create a new rule. Define your conditions and the action to take.
